symptom: The production admin could render Hebrew in an unapproved typeface or flash an uncontrolled browser fallback even though admin CSS named Heebo.
expected_behavior: Every Hebrew admin surface renders with the bundled Heebo face from the first visible paint and can fall back only to modern sans-serif Arial.
environment: VII production version 423 at https://vii.spaplus.co/admin/catalog-sync and local candidate on 2026-10-15.

steps: Inspect the live admin computed font family and loaded style sheets.
Inspect the repository and built CSS for Heebo font files and font-face declarations.
reproduction.evidence: The live shell computed Heebo, Assistant, Arial, sans-serif, while the repository contained no font assets and the live style sheets exposed no Heebo font-face; the root stylesheet loaded only remote Rubik.

observations.observation: Admin CSS declared Heebo by family name but the project shipped no Heebo WOFF, WOFF2, TTF or OTF asset.
observations.evidence: rg --files public returned no font assets before the repair; app/admin/admin.module.css declared Heebo,Assistant,Arial,sans-serif.

observations.observation: The root stylesheet imported Rubik only, so the Heebo name resolved through local machine availability or later fallbacks rather than a pinned project artifact.
observations.evidence: app/globals.css imported Rubik from Google Fonts and contained no Heebo font-face.

hypotheses.mechanism: Heebo was named but never supplied, leaving first paint and the final face dependent on uncontrolled local/browser fallback behavior.
hypotheses.prediction: There will be no project Heebo asset or font-face even though computed styles list Heebo.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inventory font assets and font-face rules and compare them with live computed styles.
hypotheses.result: No Heebo asset or font-face existed; live computed styles still listed the unresolved family name.

hypotheses.mechanism: An explicit serif, calligraphic or decorative font rule in an admin component overrode the shell.
hypotheses.prediction: A forbidden family declaration will appear in app/admin source or built admin CSS.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search the complete admin source family for serif, Georgia, Times, David, Frank, Narkisim, cursive, fantasy and ui-serif declarations.
hypotheses.result: No forbidden admin family declaration was found; the failure was missing font delivery rather than an explicit decorative override.

fix.change: Bundle the Hebrew and Latin Heebo v28 WOFF2 subsets, preload them only for admin routes, emit critical font-face and admin stack CSS in the initial HTML head, and scope every non-code admin descendant to VII Heebo, Arial, sans-serif.
fix.evidence: Typography audit passed; both font files returned 200 font/woff2; Hebrew glyph probe passed; desktop and 390px cold/warm first-paint automation and visual inspection passed.

affected_family: buttons, links, headings, fields, labels, tables, loading, error and modal states
cold navigation, warm navigation and browser cache restoration

regression_checks.evidence: audit_font_sources.py passed for the project root.
fontTools probe confirmed Hebrew letters and the shekel sign in heebo-hebrew-v28.woff2.

regression_checks.check: Desktop and mobile cold/warm first paint

regression_checks.evidence: pnpm test completed with 728/728 passing tests.

remaining_unknowns: The exact production release still requires deployment and repetition of the live first-paint checks.
authorization_boundary: Repair and prepare the admin typography and logout candidate; production publication remains part of the already authorized VII release but must be verified on the exact deployed version.
